aboutText: Mula Group is a technology group combining AI, software, e-commerce, marketing, cybersecurity, and engineering. We help companies transition from operational chaos to structured, scalable operating systems.

pillars.title: AI Technologies
pillars.subtitle: Artificial intelligence and automation
pillars.description: We implement AI that genuinely reduces service time, automates repetitive tasks, and gives companies an operational edge. From simple copilots to multi-agent architectures — always focused on concrete business outcomes.

pillars.title: Digital Transformation
pillars.subtitle: Enterprise digitization and automation
pillars.description: We help companies eliminate manual processes, integrate fragmented systems, and gain full control over their data. We deploy CRM, ERP, and workflows that genuinely shorten task completion times and reduce error rates.

pillars.title: E-commerce
pillars.subtitle: Multi-channel sales and marketplaces
pillars.description: We expand sales reach and reduce operational costs. We connect online stores with marketplaces into a single system that automatically syncs inventory, orders, and pricing.

pillars.title: Marketing & Media
pillars.subtitle: Strategy, creative, visibility
pillars.description: We boost visibility and generate leads that genuinely convert into sales. We combine SEO, ad campaigns, and content marketing into a measurable system that we continuously optimize based on data.

pillars.title: Cybersecurity
pillars.subtitle: Infrastructure protection and compliance
pillars.description: We protect businesses from costly downtime, data leaks, and non-compliance penalties. We deploy monitoring, backup, and documentation for NIS2 and ISO 27001 compliance.

pillars.title: Construction & Engineering
pillars.subtitle: Steel structures and construction projects
pillars.description: We deliver steel structures and construction projects from concept to assembly — on time and to specification. We use AI tools to optimize costs and schedules.

pillars.title: Innovation & Startup Studio
pillars.subtitle: Proprietary products and new ventures
pillars.description: We develop proprietary SaaS products, build MVPs, and conduct R&D. We explore new business models at the intersection of AI, automation, and real market needs.

faq.question: What does Mula Group do?
faq.answer: Mula Group is a business ecosystem combining 7 competencies in one operational environment. We deal with AI technologies, digital transformation, e-commerce, marketing, cybersecurity, construction, and innovation. Instead of seeking multiple vendors, you get one partner with a full spectrum of services.

faq.question: What does the collaboration process look like?
faq.answer: We work in a 6-stage model: Analysis (diagnosis), Strategy (solution design), Design (architecture and integrations), Implementation (technical execution), Automation (connecting competencies and workflows), and Growth (scaling and optimization). Every project begins with a deep understanding of your business, challenges, and goals — only then do we design the solution.

faq.question: Do you work with small businesses?
faq.answer: Yes, we work with both small and medium-sized enterprises. We scale our solutions to match the organization's size and budget. We believe access to modern technologies and automation should be possible at every stage of a company's development.

faq.question: What technologies do you use?
faq.answer: We use a modern technology stack including Next.js, TypeScript, React, Python, LangChain, OpenAI API, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Docker, and many others. We don't impose a single technology — we select tools optimal for the scale and needs of your business.

faq.question: How long does project implementation take?
faq.answer: Implementation time depends on the scale and complexity of the project — from a few weeks for simple deployments to several months for complex systems. At the Design stage, we present a detailed schedule with milestones, so you always know where we stand.

faq.question: Do you offer post-launch support?
faq.answer: Yes, post-launch support is an integral part of our offering. We provide monitoring, maintenance, and development of deployed systems. The growth phase in our methodology means we don't leave you after launch — we build a long-term partnership.
